 “GARDEN BLOOMS: Rumors are swirling that Soundgarden will embark next year on its first tour since frontman Chris Cornell's suicide in 2017, seemingly improbable given the long history of rancor among surviving band members Matt Cameron, Kim Thayil and Ben Shepherd and Cornell's widow, Vicky. However, a 2023 settlement paved the way for the musicians to finish the songs for which Cornell had already recorded vocals. The group did reunite with guest singers Brandi Carlile and The Pretty Reckless' Taylor Momsen for its 2025 induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame.
